literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) describe a single construct: the Cdh6-HA knock-in mouse in which two tandem HA copies are inserted in-frame at the CDH6 stop codon (C-terminus, after residue 790). CDH6 is a type-I single-pass cadherin; the topology landmarks place residues 635–790 in the intracellular compartment. The HA tag therefore faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface, and the site is recorded in other_positions. No ledger line reports any tag insertion at an extracellular position — not at the mature N-terminus (residue 19), not in any of the five extracellular cadherin-repeat domains (residues 19–613), and not in any inter-domain linker. Because the rules forbid proposing sites not grounded in the ledger, sites is empty.

literature_other_positions.note: Two tandem HA copies inserted in-frame at the CDH6 stop codon (after residue 790, S); the C-terminus lies in the intracellular span (residues 635–790), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
